messages.subject: Harborlight — first-year invoicing
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Accounts,

Now that Harborlight is live (go-live confirmed 9 Feb), please raise the year-one invoice: £285k platform + £95k data licence + £38k premium support + £60k onboarding, payable net 30. PO number to follow from Harborlight procurement.

Thanks,
Daniel
